newsitem.title: USA: Cali Realty completes stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Cali Realty completes stock offering.

text.p: Cali Realty Corp said Tuesday it had completed a public offering of 15,250,000 shares priced at $26-5/8 per share.
The offering will result in aggregate net proceeds to the company of about $383 million, Cali said.

About $144 million of the proceeds will be used to repay debt drawn under the company's credit facilities in connection with recent acquisitions. The balance will go to pending property acquisitions and for general corporate purposes, it said.
Underwriters for the deal included Prudential Securities Inc, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
Shares of Cali Realty were at 27, up 1/8, in mid-morning trading.
